title: 台灣投票日演出觀測 Taiwan Election-Day Events Watch — raw data

creators.name: Yip, Kam-lung Sam
creators.affiliation: Center for Asian Studies, Kanagawa University

description:
Pre-publication raw data release. Raw open data on events held in Taiwan on Saturday 28 November 2026, the polling day of Taiwan's local elections and a national referendum. Contents: the 14 events listed by ticketing and official pages; every organiser, co-organiser, producer and sponsor credit as printed (37 rows); registry records for 24 credited companies and parents (equity status, capital, directors, supervisors, holdings; 61 rows) from Taiwan's company registry; the national polling days compared (9 rows); raw event listings (420 rows), dated news reports (95 rows) and per-event detail with stated organisers (90 rows) for national polling days since 2016 and nearby Saturdays; and political-donation register extracts for the credited companies' groups (41 rows, no party labels). The release contains no analysis, classification or conclusions; those appear only on the author's web page https://www.samyip.net/tw-election-day-events/.

中文：台灣 2026 年 11 月 28 日投票日演出的原始公開資料：演出清單、依頁面原文的主辦／協辦／製作／贊助、掛名公司的商工登記資料（股權狀況、資本額、董監事與持股），以及 2016 年以來歷屆投票日的日期、原始檔期清單、新聞報導、個別演出資料，與政治獻金登錄摘錄（不標示政黨）。本發布不含任何分析或結論。

Funding: part of the output of the Kanagawa University Center for Asian Studies FY2026 Individual Research Incentive Grant (個別奨励研究助成), The Development and Transformation of Japan's Content Business in East Asia: A Comparative Area Study of Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Mainland China (「東アジアにおける日本コンテンツ事業の展開と変容――香港・台湾・中国大陸を対象とした比較地域研究」) (PI: Kam-lung Sam Yip).

AI use: compiled with the assistance of Anthropic's Claude models (via Claude Code); the author verifies the data against the cited sources before each version is finalised.

Conflict of interest: the author has worked since 2009 as a concert promoter for Japanese and Korean artists; the author took no part in any listed event and has had no business dealings with the credited organisers or co-organisers in the past five years.
notes: Edition 1: 115年地方公職人員選舉 (2026-11-28). Later elections are added as new versions under the same concept DOI. Upstream source terms: see LICENSE-CONTENT.md.
